name: Freya Isozaki
source:
Freya is extremely powerful and especially dangerous to demons, as she has already fought the Dark Lords in the past.
Her height is unstable, so she can be as tall as an ordinary human or become a true giant. She is [url=/c144576]Orphea[/url]'s grandmother.
The moment [url=/c144566]I[/url] saw her, I immediately realized that I couldn't possibly pass up a woman like her.

[In game description]
